canonical_example.text: Urge regular la temperatura en la sala de juntas.
canonical_example.translation: The temperature in the conference room needs to be adjusted.

canonical_example.text: El capitán del submarino ordenó cerrar todas las escotillas.
canonical_example.translation: The captain of the submarine ordered the hatches to battened down.

canonical_example.text: El agua se filtraba por las escotillas.
canonical_example.translation: Water was leaking in through the hatchways.

canonical_example.text: El tenista escocés ganó su séptima medalla en el partido de ayer.
canonical_example.translation: The Scottish tennis player won his seventh medal in yesterday's match.

canonical_example.text: Séptimo, reinicia la computadora.
canonical_example.translation: Seventh, restart your computer.

canonical_example.text: Mi abuelo era el séptimo de diez hermanos.
canonical_example.translation: My grandfather was the seventh of ten siblings.

canonical_example.text: Un séptimo de los beneficios se dona a obras sociales.
canonical_example.translation: One-seventh of the profits is donated to social works.

canonical_example.text: Estoy buscando un nuevo desafío.
canonical_example.translation: I'm looking for a new challenge.

canonical_example.text: Buscamos cambios fundamentales en el modelo de negocio para asegurar nuestro futuro.
canonical_example.translation: We're seeking fundamental changes in our business model to secure our future.

canonical_example.text: Estuve esperando a que mi hermano viniera a buscarme para ir a almorzar.
canonical_example.translation: I was waiting for my brother to come and pick me up for lunch.

canonical_example.text: Busca bien. En alguna parte tienen que estar.
canonical_example.translation: Look properly. They must be somewhere.

canonical_example.text: Debemos centrarnos en buscar una solución al problema.
canonical_example.translation: We must focus on trying to find a solution to the problem.

canonical_example.text: Cuando entré en la discoteca, busqué a mis amigos con la mirada, pero no los vi.
canonical_example.translation: When I went into the club, I tried to spot my friends, but couldn't see them.

canonical_example.text: Sus ojos recorrieron la habitación, buscándola.
canonical_example.translation: His eyes went around the room, looking for her.

canonical_example.text: Busca el número en el catálogo.
canonical_example.translation: Look up the number in the catalog.

canonical_example.text: Ese hermano tuyo siempre anda buscando problemas.
canonical_example.translation: That brother of yours is always looking for trouble.

canonical_example.text: No busco pelea, solo quiero que me escuches.
canonical_example.translation: I'm not picking a fight. I just want you to listen to what I have to say.

canonical_example.text: Tengo que ir a buscar las flores para la fiesta.
canonical_example.translation: I need to go to fetch the flowers for the party.

canonical_example.text: Pasé la tarde buscando ofertas de vacaciones en Internet.
canonical_example.translation: I spent the afternoon searching for vacation deals on the Internet.

canonical_example.text: Se está buscado problemas si sigue así.
canonical_example.translation: He's asking for trouble if he continues like that.

canonical_example.text: Tú te lo buscaste. No culpes a nadie más.
canonical_example.translation: You brought it on yourself. Don't blame anyone else.

canonical_example.text: Tuve un día largo y preciso descansar.
canonical_example.translation: I had a long day, and I need to rest.

canonical_example.text: No pude descansar anoche.
canonical_example.translation: I couldn't sleep last night.

canonical_example.text: Últimamente tengo mucho trabajo y solo descanso los domingos.
canonical_example.translation: I have a lot of work on lately and only have a break on Sundays.

canonical_example.text: Deberías descansar los fines de semana.
canonical_example.translation: You should take it easy on weekends.

canonical_example.text: Él descansó un rato después de almorzar.
canonical_example.translation: He napped for a while after eating lunch.

canonical_example.text: En este lugar las almas desafortunadas pueden descansar en paz.
canonical_example.translation: This is a place where unfortunate souls can rest in peace.

canonical_example.text: El campo descansa un año entero cada tres años.
canonical_example.translation: The field rests for a full year once every three years.

canonical_example.text: Tomó el dinero y se lo metió en el bolsillo.
canonical_example.translation: He took the money and put it in his pocket.

canonical_example.text: Él tiene que tomar sus medicamentos dos veces al día.
canonical_example.translation: He has to take his medication twice a day.

canonical_example.text: Tuve que tomar el tren para ir a trabajar.
canonical_example.translation: I had to take the train to go to work.

canonical_example.text: El enemigo tomó la ciudad en un día.
canonical_example.translation: The enemy took the city in a day.

canonical_example.text: Sal y toma un poco de aire fresco.
canonical_example.translation: Go out and get some fresh air.

canonical_example.text: Tienes que tomar mucha agua en estos días tan calurosos.
canonical_example.translation: You have to drink a lot of water on such hot days.

canonical_example.text: Necesito tomarme un respiro del trabajo.
canonical_example.translation: I need to take a break from work.

canonical_example.text: Aún se toma demasiado.
canonical_example.translation: He still drinks too much.

canonical_example.text: Tomé atún para el almuerzo.
canonical_example.translation: I had tuna fish for lunch.

canonical_example.text: ¿Quieres una copa de vino? - Gracias, pero no tomo.
canonical_example.translation: Would you like a glass of wine? - Thanks, but I don't drink.

canonical_example.text: ¿Cómo se lo tomó?
canonical_example.translation: How did he take it?

canonical_example.text: Voy a tomarme un mojito.
canonical_example.translation: I'm going to have a mojito.
